name: Zhongce Rubber Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongce Rubber Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of tire products in China. The company offers all-steel tires used in heavy-duty trucks, long-distance passenger vehicles, and engineering machinery vehicles; semi-steel tires mainly used in passenger cars such as sedans, SUVs, and commercial vehicles; bias tires, including agricultural and pneumatic tires for industrial vehicles; and solid tires for industrial vehicles.
